topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines the expected learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations drive clonal succession and cellular transformation during cancer evolution.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchies and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the cancer stem cell model and investigate how normal tissue hierarchies and the cell of origin influence tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influences and stromal support in tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammatory signals, environmental promoters, and stromal interactions facilitate tumor progression and offer therapeutic targets.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the experimental sequencing technologies and computational approaches used to resolve tumor heterogeneity and cellular architecture.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesises how mutational processes, cellular origin, epigenetic plasticity, and environmental contexts converge to drive malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
